target: Season 06 base game; wiki revisions retrieved 2026-11-17. This is a reference review, not an in-game certification of hidden mechanics.
limitations: Base/upgrade/overclock tables were compared for all 24 weapons; follow_up records the unresolved differences and calculation gaps.
Existing IDs, names, slots, and loadout links are preserved. Only listed corrections are proposed; no live database writes are performed by the audit.
Advanced build_metrics remain separate and are not regenerated.
Wiki pages may retain Season 05 update banners; current sources can be incomplete or rounded.
Integer rounding, conditional damage, heat, locks, modes, burst timing and other special effects require separate calculator work where noted.

If the first enemy hit by the shot is suffering from any Corrosion, Electrocution, Neurotoxin, Persistent Plasma, or Slowdown Status Effects caused by a player, then any enemies hit afterwards will have the base version of those Status Effects applied to them too. Additionally, if the first enemy hit is either On Fire or Frozen, then it will transfer Heat or Cold (respectively) to any enemies hit afterwards. For a full explanation of how this OC works and the enumerated Status Effect whitelist, go to the Wiki.gg DRG Wiki for further reading.
